title: Free ai model for making games
author: Baron_2077
selftext:
Well i know this question has been asked many times, but what AI models out there are free and pretty decent for making webgames?

Here is my hardware in case you suggest local models (but its kinda shit, idk what kind of models can run on my laptop):

Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 PRO 5675U with Radeon Graphics (2.30 GHz)

installed RAM: 24,0 GB (19,8 GB usable)  
Graphics card: AMD Radeon (TM) Graphics (4 GB)

  
thx in advance

comments.author: Only4uArt
comments.body:
Sorry I don't want to sound harsh.

But free ai and 200$ budget pc won't work unless you want to use a model so dumbed down you might as well use gemini in [google.com](http://google.com)

replies.author: frigginwizard420
replies.body: na don't quit, just get the $20/m claude code, run it with the desktop app, in code mode rather than chat mode so you can give it access to your project folder. Stick to opus 5.5, only run one agent at a time, and watch the size of its context, if you can keep it under 150k it really cuts down on usage.

replies.author: Schnitzhole
replies.body:
Desktop app works just fine to access folders since the beginning of this year.

He can probably get 90% of the things he wants done with cheaper models of claude though I do thing Opus 5.5 is way more efficient with tokens. That doesn’t mean Opus 5.5 can’t chug all usage in an hour though.

comments.author: semantic_miasis
comments.body: Open code Go usando DeepSeek flash es prácticamente ilimitado, 10$ USD mensuales y estás listo

comments.author: frigginwizard420
comments.body:
these models rely almost exclusively on your GPU and its vram  

The best model I can run on my rtx 5070 with 12gb vram maxes out at around 16k of context, so it can handle writing small scripts and functions as long as I can explain it easily.   
Claude code handles 1m of context, it has an understanding of my project in its context.  

The difference is gigantic

comments.author: Ukawok92
comments.body: Just get the $20 Claude sub if you wanna try it out for a month or two.

comments.author: No_Thanks_7089
comments.body:
Openrouter.ai and use free models that are up for 2 weeks or sometimes longer. That's the best way you'll get free and somewhat competent. Things like flint will do basic tasks. For web stuff it'll probably work. 

What I would do for the best output is get a free month with chatgpt but before hand work on your goal, brief and aim for the game. Then you'll have one month to get it all done. That will give you the best result and be the easiest. Dont go into it aimless or your waste weeks figuring out your goal and keep changing the scope and direction.

comments.author: FragmentedHeap
comments.body:
Your laptop is a potato, not good for much, not running AI on it that's anywhere near "acceptable" that's for sure.

Get an AI sub.

Deepseek v4.1 flash 1017 is good, and much cheaper than claude.

comments.author: Sirramza
comments.body:
[https://aistudio.google.com/](https://aistudio.google.com/)

gemini 3.8 flash

for something that its free, it has a lot of ussage, and when its get depleted for the day, you can go to 3.7, 3.6, 3.5, etc

comments.author: lorendroll
comments.body:
ZCode gives 300M tokens for GLM every day for free + OpenCode DeepSeek daily free promo. Enough for hours of work. 
For $5 you can also get DeepSeek on deeprelay. Cheapest offer you can get right now, afaik.

comments.author: Full-Run4124
comments.body: You "can" run a Q4 Codestral GGUF model locally with koboldcpp for free. It will allocate the resources it finds on your laptop to run the model. It's going to run very slow on your system but you can test it and it won't cost anything.

comments.author: Sacred_B
comments.body: $20 Claude sub is handling what I'm throwing at it so far. It's pretty easy to hit your 5 hour limit in 2 if you don't manage your prompts well :P After the first week, I'm figuring out how to be more conservative with suggesting how it does things while keeping it from going ape.

comments.author: Dthcon
comments.body: haiku 5.5 and sonnet 5.5  are technically free and it's probably even overkill for your needs. But obviously this has limited usage. You can use this for harder tasks. Free unlimited AI is garbage, at least buy for $10 some deepseek usage, it's almost free and for sure good enough for you. If you are not able to spent even $10 to make your game then your problem is somewhere else.

comments.author: KingofKingsofKingsof
comments.body: I use Claude $20 per month license and I've found that more than adequate for part time (like evening, a bit at the weekend) dev.
